name: Jungfraubahn Holding AG
summary: Jungfraubahn Holding AG, together with its subsidiaries, operates cogwheel railway and winter sports related facilities in Jungfrau region, and Switzerland. It operates through Jungfraujoch  Top of Europe, Winter Sports, Experience Mountains, and Secondary Business segments. The company's destinations include Jungfraujoch, Grindelwald-First, Schynige Platte, Harder Kulm, Winteregg Mürren, and Kleine Scheidegg. In addition, it offers tourist railways, cableways, skiing, flyer, glider, mountain cart, Trotti bike scooter, hiking, sledging, and shopping; food and beverages; and restaurant services, as well as operates a hydroelectric power station.
